adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the code iterates `usernames.split(",")` and only adds when `User.find_by_username(username)` returns a user; missing usernames are silently ignored and the action still returns `success_json` if `group.save` succeeds (which it can even if nothing was added). The diff also removes the prior spec coverage for this behavior (`"succeeds silently when adding non-existent users"` in the old incremental PATCH tests) and adds new `add_members` specs without any replacement asserting/documenting the silent-drop semantics for the new endpoint. This is a concrete, diff-grounded gap in regression coverage/behavior contract rather than a definitive newly introduced defect.
